constraints.acceptance: A valid source registration should naturally make this signature coherent while preserving the same corridor.

constraints.name: extraction unit
constraints.acceptance: Must produce a human-readable instruction or checksum-valid compact key-like unit from a rule that follows from source/clue evidence.

constraints.name: physical leaf/spread support
constraints.acceptance: A physical scan/photo should show real front/back, spread, bleed-through, or fold behavior that selects the corridor.

constraints.name: opener capsule provenance

constraints.name: five-index locator

constraints.name: announcement media coverage

constraints.name: Canva/source image quality

constraints.name: orientation/source cache bridge
constraints.acceptance: Use readable/upright geometry or rotate native source/PDF images 180 degrees before applying page-76 crop coordinates.
